Two entries in this batch (B00748 Dr. Meetu Soni and B00749 The Smile Express) share the same address, suite and phone; they are the same business, so their opportunities overlap and should not be sold twice.

Review-complaint analysis (missed calls, slow replies) was not possible because Google review text could not be opened; operations signals are therefore based on site/booking mechanics rather than customer complaints.
Healthquest Chiropractic (B00760) is the thinnest record in the batch - directory listings and a bare Google pin only. It is marked operating on that basis, not on first-party confirmation.
data_gaps: smilebriteusa.com returned a Cloudflare 403 block page on 5 attempts (two networks, browser and fetch), so its booking flow, form fields, mobile layout and schema could not be verified.
Google review counts were unavailable for all ten businesses; only star ratings (and one Birdeye aggregate of 33 reviews for SmileBrite) could be captured.
Cornerstone Orthodontics names no provider anywhere on its site, so we could not attribute the practice to a specific orthodontist.
No separate Google Business Profile was found for Dr. Meetu Soni as an individual provider; only a Healthgrades profile.
Healthquest Chiropractic hours come from a directory summary, not the practice; no first-party source exists.
